description: Placed on its plinth in 1969 as a monument to 1. Pułk Lotnictwa Myśliwskiego "Warszawa". Described by the mapper as a MiG-15 on a plinth; Polish monuments of this vintage are normally WSK-built Lim-2s. The 1969 date is the monument's erection and is NOT used as year_built. No serial
aliases: MiG15; Lim-1; Lim-2; Lim2; Fagot; Lim1
museum_name: MiG-15 Monument to 1. Pułk Lotnictwa Myśliwskiego "Warszawa" -- Warka
